summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave Clonidine Hydrochloride a medium liver score and a low heart score [M]. Patients are warned not to stop taking this medicine suddenly without talking to their doctor [4]. Stopping treatment abruptly can lead to nervousness, agitation, headache, tremor or shaking, and a fast increase in blood pressure [4].
